words.enDefinition: Blood considered together with its plasma, cells, and platelets

examples.en: The chart represents whole blood as a mixture of liquid and suspended components.
examples.zh: 图表将「全血」表示为液体和悬浮成分的混合物。

examples.en: We used separate colors for the main components shown in the whole blood diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色表示「全血」示意图中的各主要成分。

words.enDefinition: Liquid portion of circulating blood carrying dissolved substances and suspended formed elements

examples.en: The drawing shows blood plasma surrounding the cells in the illustrated vessel.
examples.zh: 图中「血浆」包围着所示血管里的血细胞。

examples.en: We shaded blood plasma as the fluid portion in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中用阴影表示液体部分，也就是「血浆」。

words.enDefinition: The liquid remaining after blood has clotted, depleted of fibrinogen and other components consumed or retained in the clot.

examples.en: The textbook labels blood serum as the liquid remaining after the illustrated clot forms.
examples.zh: 教材把图示血凝块形成后剩余的液体标为「血清」。

examples.en: We compared blood serum with plasma on the chart of blood components.
examples.zh: 我们在血液成分图上比较了「血清」和血浆。

words.enDefinition: Cellular and cell-derived components of blood, including platelets and both blood cell groups

examples.en: The diagram groups red cells, white cells, and platelets as formed elements.
examples.zh: 示意图将红细胞、白细胞和血小板归为「血液有形成分」。

examples.en: We labeled the formed elements separately from the liquid portion of blood.
examples.zh: 我们将「血液有形成分」与血液的液体部分分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of the total blood volume occupied by red blood cells

examples.en: The synthetic chart depicts the hematocrit as a fraction of total volume.
examples.zh: 合成图用占血液总体积的比例表示「红细胞比容」。

examples.en: We used a smaller red band to represent lower hematocrit in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们用较窄的红色带表示图中较低的「红细胞比容」。

words.enDefinition: The thin layer containing white blood cells and platelets between the plasma and red-cell layers of separated blood.

examples.en: The buffy coat appears as a thin band between two much wider layers.
examples.zh: 「白膜层」在两个宽得多的层之间呈现为一条细带。

examples.en: We marked the buffy coat on the textbook diagram of separated blood components.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的血液成分分层图上标出了「白膜层」。

words.enDefinition: Protein present in plasma with roles such as transport, defense, or clotting

examples.en: The worksheet assigns a distinct role to each plasma protein shown in the table.
examples.zh: 习题为表中每种「血浆蛋白」列出相应的作用。

examples.en: We matched the name of a plasma protein to its role in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把一种「血浆蛋白」的名称与它在示意图中的作用配对。

words.enDefinition: Abundant blood protein that transports substances and supports colloid osmotic pressure

examples.en: The chart lists serum albumin among the proteins that carry substances in blood.
examples.zh: 图表将「血清白蛋白」列为在血液中运载物质的蛋白之一。

examples.en: We discussed serum albumin when reading about the osmotic effect of plasma proteins.
examples.zh: 阅读血浆蛋白的渗透作用时，我们讨论了「血清白蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: Group of plasma proteins with diverse roles, including transport and immune defense

examples.en: The table divides plasma globulins into groups with different roles in the body.
examples.zh: 表格将「血浆球蛋白」按人体内的作用分成几组。

examples.en: We listed an antibody as one example among the plasma globulins in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上列举了一种抗体，作为「血浆球蛋白」的一个例子。

words.enDefinition: Blood cell specialized to carry oxygen through its hemoglobin content

examples.en: The model shows an erythrocyte with a thinner middle than outer edge.
examples.zh: 模型展示了中央比外缘薄的「红细胞」。

examples.en: We identified the erythrocyte by its flattened outline in the textbook image.
examples.zh: 我们根据教材图中的扁平轮廓辨认出了「红细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Disc-shaped form with a depression in the middle of both surfaces

examples.en: The side view shows the red cell as a biconcave disc in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们的侧视图把红细胞画成「双凹圆盘」。

examples.en: We used a biconcave disc to represent the cell's shape in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用「双凹圆盘」表示模型中这种细胞的形状。

words.enDefinition: Iron-containing protein in red blood cells that reversibly binds oxygen

examples.en: The atlas places the hemoglobin symbols within the outline of the red cell.
examples.zh: 图谱将「血红蛋白」画在红细胞内部。

examples.en: We labeled hemoglobin as the oxygen-carrying protein in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中将「血红蛋白」标为携带氧的蛋白质。

words.enDefinition: Iron-containing part of hemoglobin that provides a site for oxygen binding

examples.en: We marked the heme group beside each of the colored protein chains.
examples.zh: 我们在各条有颜色的蛋白质链旁标出了「血红素基团」。

examples.en: The molecular model places iron at the center of each heme group.
examples.zh: 分子模型把铁画在每个「血红素基团」的中心。

collocations: oxygen binding at a heme group

words.enDefinition: Protein chain of hemoglobin that carries a heme group

examples.en: The diagram assigns a different shade to each globin chain in the molecule.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同色调表示分子中的各条「珠蛋白链」。

examples.en: We highlighted the globin chain to show where the heme group sits.
examples.zh: 我们高亮标出「珠蛋白链」，说明血红素基团位于何处。

collocations: heme associated with a globin chain

words.enDefinition: Form of hemoglobin with oxygen bound at one or more heme sites

examples.en: The colored diagram represents oxyhemoglobin by placing oxygen beside the binding sites.
examples.zh: 彩色示意图通过在结合位点旁画出氧，表示「氧合血红蛋白」。

examples.en: The worksheet labels oxyhemoglobin in the model whose heme sites hold oxygen.
examples.zh: 习题将血红素位点结合着氧的模型标为「氧合血红蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: Form of hemoglobin with its oxygen-binding sites unoccupied by oxygen

examples.en: The chart labels the unoccupied form as deoxyhemoglobin in the molecule model.
examples.zh: 图表把分子模型中氧结合位点空出的形态标为「脱氧血红蛋白」。

examples.en: We drew deoxyhemoglobin without the markers used to show attached oxygen.
examples.zh: 我们画出「脱氧血红蛋白」时，省去了表示已结合氧的标记。

words.enDefinition: Mass of hemoglobin per unit volume of blood

examples.en: The synthetic table reports hemoglobin concentration as mass per volume of blood.
examples.zh: 合成表以单位血液体积所含的质量表示「血红蛋白浓度」。

examples.en: We checked the units before comparing hemoglobin concentration across the fictional examples.
examples.zh: 我们先核对单位，再比较几个虚构示例中的「血红蛋白浓度」。

words.enDefinition: Number of red blood cells per unit volume of blood

examples.en: The synthetic table reports two red blood cell count values using the same volume unit.
examples.zh: 表中两列合成的「红细胞计数」使用相同的体积单位。

examples.en: We labeled the red blood cell count separately from the fraction of volume occupied.
examples.zh: 我们将「红细胞计数」与红细胞占据的体积比例分开标注。

collocations: report a red blood cell count
units for a red blood cell count

words.enDefinition: Average volume of a single red blood cell in a group

examples.en: We used circles of different sizes to illustrate mean corpuscular volume in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上用大小不同的圆圈说明「平均红细胞体积」。

examples.en: The table gives mean corpuscular volume separately from the number of red cells.
examples.zh: 表格将「平均红细胞体积」与红细胞数量分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Formation and development of the cellular components found in blood

examples.en: The chart shows hematopoiesis branching toward several different types of blood cells.
examples.zh: 图表显示，「造血」过程分出通往多种血细胞的分支。

examples.en: We discussed hematopoiesis while labeling the origins of the formed elements.
examples.zh: 我们在标注血液有形成分的来源时讨论了「造血」。

words.enDefinition: Self-renewing precursor cell able to give rise to all blood cell lineages

examples.en: The development chart places a hematopoietic stem cell above the earliest branching point.
examples.zh: 发育图把一个「造血干细胞」画在最早的分支点上方。

examples.en: We labeled the hematopoietic stem cell at the start of the textbook's lineage diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在教材谱系图的起始处标出了「造血干细胞」。

collocations: descendants of a hematopoietic stem cell
diagram of a hematopoietic stem cell

words.enDefinition: Development of new red blood cells from precursor stages

examples.en: The erythropoiesis diagram follows the red cell branch through several stages.
examples.zh: 「红细胞生成」示意图沿红细胞分支展示了多个阶段。

examples.en: We identified the final cell type shown at the end of erythropoiesis.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出了「红细胞生成」末端所示的细胞类型。

words.enDefinition: Immature red cell precursor that still contains a nucleus

examples.en: The textbook shows an erythroblast with a dark nucleus in the center.
examples.zh: 教材展示了一个中央有深色细胞核的「有核红细胞前体」。

examples.en: We placed the erythroblast before the nucleus-free stages on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们把「有核红细胞前体」放在图表中各个无核阶段之前。

words.enDefinition: Young red blood cell retaining residual ribosomal material after losing its nucleus

examples.en: The diagram places a reticulocyte just before the fully mature red cell.
examples.zh: 示意图把「网织红细胞」放在完全成熟的红细胞之前。

examples.en: The illustrated reticulocyte retains ribosomal material even after the nucleus disappears.
examples.zh: 图中「网织红细胞」失去细胞核后仍留有核糖体成分。

words.enDefinition: Hormone made mainly by the kidneys that promotes red cell production

examples.en: The teaching chart connects erythropoietin with the production of red blood cells.
examples.zh: 教学图把「促红细胞生成素」与红细胞生成联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the main source of erythropoietin beside the kidney drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在肾脏图旁标出了「促红细胞生成素」的主要来源。

words.enDefinition: Category based on the presence or absence of specified red cell markers

examples.en: The fictional card lists a blood group beside its surface marker symbols.
examples.zh: 虚构教学卡片在表面标志符号旁列出一种「血型」。

examples.en: We matched each blood group label to its red cell drawing in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上把各个「血型」标签与对应的红细胞示意图配对。

words.enDefinition: Classification of blood according to A and B markers on red cells

examples.en: The ABO blood group system chart groups four fictional examples by their red cell markers.
examples.zh: 「ABO血型系统」图表按红细胞表面标志给四个虚构示例分组。

examples.en: We filled the four labels of the ABO blood group system on our classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂习题上填写了「ABO血型系统」的四个类别标签。

collocations: classes of the ABO blood group system
diagram of the ABO blood group system
labels in the ABO blood group system

words.enDefinition: Molecular marker on a red cell surface that antibodies can recognize

examples.en: The card depicts a red cell surface antigen as a small shape on the cell edge.
examples.zh: 卡片把「红细胞表面抗原」画成细胞边缘的一个小图形。

examples.en: We labeled the red cell surface antigen beside the matching marker symbol in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中相应的标志符号旁标出了「红细胞表面抗原」。

collocations: identify a red cell surface antigen
diagram of a red cell surface antigen
recognition of a red cell surface antigen

words.enDefinition: ABO category with A markers and no B markers on red cells

examples.en: The classroom card labels type A blood beside a red cell bearing A symbols.
examples.zh: 课堂卡片在带 A 标志的红细胞旁标出「A型血」。

examples.en: We found type A blood in the column with only A markers on cells.
examples.zh: 我们在细胞表面只有 A 标志的那一列找到了「A型血」。

collocations: surface marker in type A blood

words.enDefinition: ABO category with B markers and no A markers on red cells

examples.en: The diagram uses square B symbols on cells labeled type B blood in class.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在标为「B型血」的细胞上使用方形 B 标志。

examples.en: We placed the type B blood card beneath the matching surface marker drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把「B型血」卡片放在对应的表面标志图下方。

collocations: surface marker in type B blood

words.enDefinition: ABO category with both A and B markers on red cells

examples.en: The model shows type AB blood with both marker shapes on each red cell.
examples.zh: 模型中，「AB型血」的各个红细胞上都有两种标志形状。

examples.en: We labeled type AB blood in the column containing both sets of symbols.
examples.zh: 我们把「AB型血」标在同时包含两组符号的那一列。

collocations: surface markers in type AB blood

words.enDefinition: ABO category with neither A nor B markers on red cells

examples.en: The type O blood card shows cells without either of the two ABO markers.
examples.zh: 「O型血」卡片所示的细胞上没有这两种 ABO 标志。

examples.en: We wrote type O blood under the diagram with no A or B symbols.
examples.zh: 我们在没有 A 或 B 符号的图下写上了「O型血」。

collocations: ABO marker pattern in type O blood

words.enDefinition: Classification of blood based on a group of red cell surface proteins

examples.en: The Rh blood group system table highlights one named marker on the classroom card.
examples.zh: 「Rh血型系统」的表格突出显示了课堂卡片上的一个有名称的标志。

examples.en: We read the Rh blood group system label separately from the ABO label on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中分别读取了「Rh血型系统」标签和 ABO 标签。

collocations: antigens in the Rh blood group system
diagram of the Rh blood group system
marker in the Rh blood group system

words.enDefinition: Red cell surface protein determining the commonly used positive or negative Rh label

examples.en: The chart draws the RhD antigen as a separate symbol beside the ABO markers.
examples.zh: 图表在 ABO 标志旁用一个独立符号表示「RhD抗原」。

examples.en: We located the RhD antigen on the fictional red cell illustration in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂使用的虚构红细胞插图上找到了「RhD抗原」。

words.enDefinition: Blood whose red cells carry the D marker of the Rh system

examples.en: The Rh-positive blood card includes a D symbol on each illustrated red cell.
examples.zh: 「Rh阳性血」卡片上的每个红细胞图形都带有 D 标志。

examples.en: We matched the plus sign to Rh-positive blood on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表上把加号与「Rh阳性血」配对。

words.enDefinition: Blood whose red cells lack the D marker of the Rh system

examples.en: The Rh-negative blood card shows the red cells without the D symbol.
examples.zh: 「Rh阴性血」卡片上的红细胞图形没有 D 标志。

examples.en: We matched the minus sign to Rh-negative blood on the fictional label.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构标签上把减号与「Rh阴性血」配对。

words.enDefinition: Antibody that recognizes the A antigen found on some red cells

examples.en: The diagram matches an anti-A antibody with the A marker shape on a cell.
examples.zh: 示意图把「抗A抗体」与细胞上的 A 标志形状配对。

examples.en: We labeled the anti-A antibody separately from the surface marker in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中分别标出了「抗A抗体」和细胞表面标志。

words.enDefinition: Antibody that recognizes the B antigen found on some red cells

examples.en: The model shows an anti-B antibody next to its matching red cell marker.
examples.zh: 模型把一个「抗B抗体」画在与之对应的红细胞标志旁。

examples.en: We used a distinct color for the anti-B antibody in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中用单独一种颜色表示「抗B抗体」。

words.enDefinition: Clustering of cells when antibodies link their matching surface markers

examples.en: The textbook depicts agglutination as several red cell drawings linked together.
examples.zh: 教材用相互连接的几个红细胞图形表示「凝集」。

examples.en: We labeled agglutination in the illustration where the cells form visible groups.
examples.zh: 我们将插图中细胞形成可见团簇的现象标为「凝集」。

words.enDefinition: Small cell fragment in blood that participates in forming a plug

examples.en: The platelet is drawn smaller than the red cell beside it.
examples.zh: 图中，「血小板」比旁边的红细胞小。

examples.en: We labeled each platelet in the textbook's diagram of formed elements.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的血液有形成分示意图上标出了各个「血小板」。

words.enDefinition: Large marrow cell whose cytoplasm gives rise to circulating platelets

examples.en: The lineage chart shows a megakaryocyte beside its small platelet fragments.
examples.zh: 谱系图在一个「巨核细胞」旁画出了由它产生的血小板小碎片。

examples.en: We marked the megakaryocyte at the large end of the illustrated branch.
examples.zh: 我们在图示分支较大的一端标出了「巨核细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Physiological process producing platelets from developing marrow cells called megakaryocytes

examples.en: The thrombopoiesis chart ends with many small fragments entering the circulation.
examples.zh: 「血小板生成」图以许多小碎片进入血液循环作为最后一环。

examples.en: We followed thrombopoiesis on a separate branch from red cell development.
examples.zh: 我们沿不同于红细胞发育的另一条分支查看了「血小板生成」。

words.enDefinition: Small compartment inside a platelet storing substances released during its response

examples.en: The enlarged model shows each platelet granule inside the outline of a platelet.
examples.zh: 放大模型在血小板轮廓内画出了各个「血小板颗粒」。

examples.en: We labeled a platelet granule on the diagram of the platelet interior.
examples.zh: 我们在血小板内部示意图中标出了一个「血小板颗粒」。

words.enDefinition: Physiological responses that limit blood loss after damage to a vessel

examples.en: The textbook groups the immediate local responses under hemostasis in the flowchart.
examples.zh: 教材在流程图中将立即发生的局部反应归到「生理性止血」。

examples.en: We used a vessel diagram to follow the major stages of hemostasis.
examples.zh: 我们用血管示意图梳理了「生理性止血」的主要阶段。

words.enDefinition: Brief narrowing of a vessel through contraction of its wall muscle

examples.en: The model represents vascular spasm by showing a narrower vessel at the marked site.
examples.zh: 模型通过画出标记处变窄的血管来表示「血管痉挛」。

examples.en: We labeled vascular spasm before the platelet stage in the classroom sequence.
examples.zh: 在课堂顺序图中，我们将「血管痉挛」标在血小板阶段之前。

words.enDefinition: Early blood loss control involving formation of a temporary platelet plug

examples.en: The diagram ends primary hemostasis with a temporary seal made of platelets.
examples.zh: 示意图将血小板形成临时封堵画为「一期止血」的结果。

examples.en: We placed primary hemostasis before the appearance of the reinforcing fibrin network.
examples.zh: 我们将「一期止血」标在增强封堵的纤维蛋白网出现之前。

words.enDefinition: Temporary seal formed when platelets collect at a damaged vessel site

examples.en: The platelet plug appears as a small cluster at the vessel wall.
examples.zh: 「血小板栓」在血管壁处呈现为一个小团簇。

examples.en: We highlighted the platelet plug before discussing the fibers shown around it.
examples.zh: 我们先高亮标出「血小板栓」，再讨论图中它周围的纤维。

words.enDefinition: Attachment of platelets to a damaged vessel surface or exposed supporting material

examples.en: The drawing shows platelet adhesion where the platelet first contacts the exposed surface.
examples.zh: 示意图在血小板最初接触外露表面的位置显示了「血小板黏附」。

examples.en: We marked platelet adhesion at the wall before drawing links between platelets.
examples.zh: 我们先标出血管壁处的「血小板黏附」，再画血小板之间的联接。

words.enDefinition: Change in platelet shape and behavior associated with a local hemostatic response

examples.en: The textbook represents platelet activation with protrusions on the platelet's surface.
examples.zh: 教材通过在血小板表面画出突起表示「血小板活化」。

examples.en: We drew platelet activation between initial attachment and the growing cluster.
examples.zh: 我们将「血小板活化」画在初始附着与团簇逐渐增大之间。

collocations: signs of platelet activation in a model

words.enDefinition: Joining of activated platelets to one another during plug formation

examples.en: The platelet aggregation diagram shows several platelets joining into a larger group.
examples.zh: 「血小板聚集」示意图显示几个血小板连成一个较大的团簇。

examples.en: We traced platelet aggregation from a few attached platelets to the larger cluster.
examples.zh: 我们从几个已附着的血小板沿图追踪到较大团簇，观察「血小板聚集」。

words.enDefinition: Blood protein helping platelets attach to exposed structures at a damaged vessel

examples.en: Our diagram depicts von Willebrand factor as a link between the wall and platelets.
examples.zh: 示意图把「血管性血友病因子」画成连接血管壁和血小板的桥梁。

examples.en: We labeled von Willebrand factor where the first platelets attach in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们在教材图中最先附着血小板的位置标出了「血管性血友病因子」。

collocations: platelet interaction with von Willebrand factor

words.enDefinition: Physiological stage in which fibrin stabilizes the earlier platelet plug

examples.en: The flowchart shows secondary hemostasis adding a network around the platelet plug.
examples.zh: 流程图显示，「二期止血」给血小板栓加上一层网状结构。

examples.en: We used secondary hemostasis to label the fibrin stage of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中用「二期止血」标注出现纤维蛋白的阶段。

words.enDefinition: Linked reactions converting soluble fibrinogen into a fibrin network

examples.en: The blood coagulation diagram ends with threads of fibrin around the platelet group.
examples.zh: 「血液凝固」示意图的末尾显示血小板团簇周围出现纤维蛋白丝。

examples.en: The blood coagulation flowchart begins with soluble substances and ends with a fibrin network.
examples.zh: 「血液凝固」流程图从可溶性物质开始，最终形成纤维蛋白网。

words.enDefinition: Protein or other component participating in reactions that promote blood clotting

examples.en: The textbook chart labels a coagulation factor using its conventional Roman numeral.
examples.zh: 教材图用约定的罗马数字标注一种「凝血因子」。

examples.en: We followed one coagulation factor through the shaded section of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿示意图的阴影区查看了一种「凝血因子」在图中的位置。

words.enDefinition: Series in which clotting factors activate successive factors during fibrin formation

examples.en: Our diagram of the coagulation cascade shows several arrows meeting toward the end.
examples.zh: 我们的「凝血级联反应」图显示几支箭头在接近末尾的位置汇合。

examples.en: We followed a branch of the coagulation cascade through the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们沿着课堂图中的「凝血级联反应」一路查看其中一条分支。

words.enDefinition: Branch of the classical clotting scheme beginning with factors present within blood

examples.en: The intrinsic coagulation pathway is drawn as one branch leading toward a shared segment.
examples.zh: 「内源性凝血途径」被画成通往一段共同途径的一个分支。

examples.en: We identified the intrinsic coagulation pathway on the classical diagram in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的经典凝血示意图中找到了「内源性凝血途径」。

collocations: diagram of the intrinsic coagulation pathway
factors in the intrinsic coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: Branch of the classical clotting scheme beginning with a signal from tissue factor

examples.en: The simplified chart connects tissue factor with the extrinsic coagulation pathway at its beginning.
examples.zh: 简化图将组织因子连到「外源性凝血途径」的起始处。

examples.en: We traced the extrinsic coagulation pathway to the place where both branches meet.
examples.zh: 我们沿「外源性凝血途径」追踪到两个分支的汇合处。

collocations: diagram of the extrinsic coagulation pathway
factors in the extrinsic coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: Final shared portion of the classical clotting scheme leading to fibrin formation

examples.en: Both classroom branches join before the common coagulation pathway shown near the bottom.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中的两个分支在靠近底部的「共同凝血途径」之前汇合。

examples.en: We labeled fibrin formation at the end of the common coagulation pathway diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在「共同凝血途径」示意图的末端标出了纤维蛋白的形成。

collocations: diagram of the common coagulation pathway
factors in the common coagulation pathway
end of the common coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: Cell-associated protein that helps initiate clotting when exposed to circulating blood

examples.en: The illustration places tissue factor at the exposed edge of the vessel wall.
examples.zh: 插图将「组织因子」画在血管壁外露的边缘处。

examples.en: We marked tissue factor at the beginning of one branch on the flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们在流程图其中一个分支的起点标出了「组织因子」。

words.enDefinition: Inactive precursor in plasma that is converted into thrombin during clotting

examples.en: The flowchart lists prothrombin before thrombin in the shared pathway segment.
examples.zh: 流程图在共同途径那一段把「凝血酶原」列在凝血酶之前。

examples.en: We labeled prothrombin on the precursor side of the classroom arrow.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂箭头指示的转变中，将前体一侧标为「凝血酶原」。

words.enDefinition: Enzyme formed during clotting that converts soluble fibrinogen into fibrin

examples.en: The textbook diagram connects thrombin with the formation of fibrin strands.
examples.zh: 教材图把「凝血酶」与纤维蛋白丝的形成联系起来。

examples.en: We placed thrombin after its precursor on the simplified pathway chart.
examples.zh: 我们在简化途径图中把「凝血酶」放在其前体之后。

words.enDefinition: Soluble plasma protein that is converted into fibrin during clotting

examples.en: The diagram shows fibrinogen in the liquid before the strands appear.
examples.zh: 图中，在纤维丝出现之前，液体里已经有「纤维蛋白原」。

examples.en: We placed fibrinogen on the soluble side of the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂对比图中把「纤维蛋白原」放在可溶性成分的一侧。

words.enDefinition: Insoluble protein forming strands that strengthen the structure of a blood clot

examples.en: The drawing uses fibrin strands to show how the plug is reinforced.
examples.zh: 图中用「纤维蛋白」丝表示血小板栓如何得到加固。

examples.en: We shaded the network of fibrin around the cell cluster in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上给细胞团簇周围的「纤维蛋白」网涂了阴影。

words.enDefinition: Compaction of a formed clot through contractions exerted by its platelets

examples.en: The animation represents clot retraction by showing the clot become more compact.
examples.zh: 动画用血凝块逐渐变紧实来表示「血凝块回缩」。

examples.en: We placed clot retraction after the fibrin network had formed in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「血凝块回缩」标在纤维蛋白网形成之后。

words.enDefinition: Physiological breakdown of the fibrin network after a clot has formed

examples.en: The textbook shows fibrinolysis as the gradual disappearance of the fibrin strands.
examples.zh: 教材将纤维蛋白丝逐渐消失的过程画成「纤维蛋白溶解」。

examples.en: We labeled fibrinolysis at the stage where the illustrated network breaks apart.
examples.zh: 我们在图示纤维网分解的阶段标注了「纤维蛋白溶解」。

words.enDefinition: Enzyme that breaks down fibrin in the body's normal clot removal process

examples.en: The flowchart connects plasmin with the breakdown of the pictured fibrin mesh.
examples.zh: 流程图将「纤溶酶」与图中的纤维蛋白网分解联系起来。

examples.en: We marked plasmin on the active side of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中将活性形式的一侧标为「纤溶酶」。

words.enDefinition: Inactive precursor that can be converted into the enzyme plasmin

examples.en: The textbook places plasminogen before the active form on the diagram.
examples.zh: 教材把「纤溶酶原」画在活性形式之前。

examples.en: We identified the label for plasminogen beside the arrow leading to plasmin.
examples.zh: 我们在通向纤溶酶的箭头旁找到了「纤溶酶原」的标签。

words.enDefinition: Network of vessels and organs returning tissue fluid and supporting immune functions

examples.en: The lymphatic system diagram shows small vessels joining larger channels across the body.
examples.zh: 「淋巴系统」示意图显示人体各处的小淋巴管汇入较大的通道。

examples.en: We traced the lymphatic system alongside the blood circulation in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂插图中沿血液循环路径旁查看了「淋巴系统」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue-derived fluid traveling through vessels that drain into the venous circulation

examples.en: The diagram labels the fluid as lymph once it enters the small vessel.
examples.zh: 当液体进入这根小淋巴管后，示意图将其标为「淋巴液」。

examples.en: We used a distinct color for lymph in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中用一种单独的颜色表示「淋巴液」。

words.enDefinition: Tiny blind-ended vessel that receives fluid from the spaces between cells

examples.en: The lymphatic capillary begins with a closed end in the illustrated tissue.
examples.zh: 图示组织中，「毛细淋巴管」从一个封闭的端点开始。

examples.en: We placed the lymphatic capillary beside a small area of tissue fluid.
examples.zh: 我们把「毛细淋巴管」画在一小片组织间液旁。

words.enDefinition: Larger vessel receiving fluid from smaller lymphatic channels and carrying it onward

examples.en: Several small vessels join one collecting lymphatic vessel in the textbook diagram.
examples.zh: 教材图中，几根较小的淋巴管汇入一根「集合淋巴管」。

examples.en: We followed the collecting lymphatic vessel toward a node shown farther along the path.
examples.zh: 我们沿「集合淋巴管」追踪到通路上更远处的淋巴结。

collocations: branches of a collecting lymphatic vessel
diagram of a collecting lymphatic vessel

words.enDefinition: Fold within a vessel that limits backward movement of lymph

examples.en: The arrows around a lymphatic valve indicate one main direction of flow.
examples.zh: 「淋巴管瓣膜」周围的箭头标明一个主要流动方向。

examples.en: We labeled the lymphatic valve between two segments of the same vessel.
examples.zh: 我们在同一根管道的两段之间标出了「淋巴管瓣膜」。

words.enDefinition: Large vessel collecting lymph from vessels draining a particular body region

examples.en: The diagram shows smaller pathways converging to form a lymphatic trunk.
examples.zh: 示意图显示较小的通路汇合形成一条「淋巴干」。

examples.en: We marked each lymphatic trunk before following the flow into a central duct.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各条「淋巴干」，再沿流向追踪到中央的淋巴导管。

words.enDefinition: Major channel carrying lymph from regional trunks toward the venous circulation

examples.en: The lymphatic duct joins the venous pathway near the top of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型靠近顶部的位置，「淋巴导管」汇入静脉通路。

examples.en: We followed one lymphatic duct from the trunks to the shaded vein.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「淋巴导管」从淋巴干追踪到用阴影表示的静脉。

words.enDefinition: Largest lymphatic duct returning lymph from most of the body

examples.en: The thoracic duct rises through the chest in the whole body diagram.
examples.zh: 全身示意图中，「胸导管」穿过胸部向上延伸。

examples.en: We labeled the thoracic duct after tracing the larger of the central routes.
examples.zh: 我们沿两条中央通路中较大的一条描画，并标出了「胸导管」。

words.enDefinition: Duct typically draining the right upper region of the body into veins

examples.en: The chart shows the right lymphatic duct as a short channel near the neck.
examples.zh: 图表将「右淋巴导管」画成颈部附近的一条短通道。

examples.en: We shaded the region connected to the right lymphatic duct in our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中给与「右淋巴导管」相连的区域涂上阴影。

collocations: drainage into the right lymphatic duct
diagram of the right lymphatic duct

words.enDefinition: Enlarged collecting region near the lower end of the thoracic duct

examples.en: The cisterna chyli appears as a widened segment low in the illustrated trunk.
examples.zh: 「乳糜池」出现在图示躯干下部，呈现为一段变宽的结构。

examples.en: We marked the cisterna chyli just before the thoracic pathway begins to rise.
examples.zh: 我们在胸导管通路开始上行之前的位置标出了「乳糜池」。

words.enDefinition: Movement of fluid through lymphatic vessels from tissues toward the circulation

examples.en: The illustration uses arrows to show lymphatic drainage from the modeled tissues.
examples.zh: 插图用箭头表示来自模型组织的「淋巴回流」。

examples.en: We compared two regions by tracing their paths of lymphatic drainage.
examples.zh: 我们分别描画两个区域的「淋巴回流」路径，并作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Milky lymph carrying absorbed fats from the small intestine

examples.en: The classroom chart labels chyle on the path leaving the small intestine.
examples.zh: 课堂图表在离开小肠的淋巴通路上标出了「乳糜」。

examples.en: We colored chyle differently to represent its fat content in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色表示示意图中的「乳糜」，以突出其中含有脂肪。

words.enDefinition: Small organized structure along lymphatic vessels where lymph passes through immune tissue

examples.en: The illustration shows a lymph node along one of the collecting vessels.
examples.zh: 插图在一根集合淋巴管上画出了一个「淋巴结」。

examples.en: We labeled the outer and inner regions of one lymph node in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上标出了一个「淋巴结」的内外区域。

collocations: lymph passing through a lymph node

words.enDefinition: Channel carrying lymph into a lymph node from nearby tissues or vessels

examples.en: The arrow in an afferent lymphatic vessel points toward the node in our drawing.
examples.zh: 图中「输入淋巴管」内的箭头指向淋巴结。

examples.en: We marked each afferent lymphatic vessel entering the curved surface of the model node.
examples.zh: 我们标出了从模型淋巴结曲面进入的各根「输入淋巴管」。

collocations: flow through an afferent lymphatic vessel
diagram of an afferent lymphatic vessel

words.enDefinition: Channel carrying lymph away from a node toward other drainage routes

examples.en: The efferent lymphatic vessel leaves the node near its inward curve in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「输出淋巴管」从淋巴结的内凹处引出。

examples.en: We used an outward arrow to label the efferent lymphatic vessel in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上用朝外的箭头标出「输出淋巴管」。

collocations: flow through an efferent lymphatic vessel
diagram of an efferent lymphatic vessel

words.enDefinition: Outer region of a lymph node containing clusters of lymphocytes

examples.en: The ring of shaded tissue represents the lymph node cortex in the section.
examples.zh: 截面图中，以阴影表示的环形组织代表「淋巴结皮质」。

examples.en: We marked several cell clusters inside the lymph node cortex on the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图的「淋巴结皮质」中标出了几个细胞群。

collocations: cells of the lymph node cortex
diagram of the lymph node cortex

words.enDefinition: Inner region of a lymph node containing lymphatic channels and cell cords

examples.en: The lymph node medulla is drawn inside the outer band of the modeled node.
examples.zh: 在淋巴结模型中，「淋巴结髓质」画在外带以内。

examples.en: We labeled the deeper channels in the lymph node medulla on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图中标出了「淋巴结髓质」深处的管道。

collocations: channels of the lymph node medulla
diagram of the lymph node medulla

words.enDefinition: Lymph-filled channel directly beneath the outer capsule of a lymph node

examples.en: The subcapsular sinus follows the node's outer edge beneath the drawn capsule.
examples.zh: 图中，「被膜下窦」位于被膜下方，沿淋巴结外缘延伸。

examples.en: We placed the subcapsular sinus just inside the capsule on our labeled diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「被膜下窦」标在图中靠近被膜内侧的位置。

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid organ that filters blood and helps remove aging red cells

examples.en: The spleen sits high on the left side of the abdominal model.
examples.zh: 在腹部模型中，「脾脏」位于左侧较高的位置。

examples.en: We colored the spleen next to the stomach in the torso diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在躯干图中给胃旁的「脾脏」上色。

words.enDefinition: Blood-rich region of the spleen involved in filtering aging red cells

examples.en: The section shows splenic red pulp across much of the enlarged model's interior.
examples.zh: 截面图显示「脾红髓」占放大模型内部的大部分。

examples.en: We located vessels within the splenic red pulp on the colored atlas figure.
examples.zh: 我们在彩图图谱的「脾红髓」中找到了血管。

collocations: blood vessels of the splenic red pulp
diagram of the splenic red pulp

words.enDefinition: Immune tissue of the spleen arranged around branches of its arteries

examples.en: The splenic white pulp forms pale islands around small arterial branches in the figure.
examples.zh: 图中，「脾白髓」在小动脉分支周围形成浅色岛状区域。

examples.en: We marked the splenic white pulp separately from the larger blood-rich region.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了「脾白髓」和较大的富血区域。

collocations: lymphocytes in the splenic white pulp
diagram of the splenic white pulp

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid organ where developing T lymphocytes mature and undergo selection

examples.en: The model places the thymus high in the chest behind the breastbone.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胸腺」位于胸部上方、胸骨后方。

examples.en: We marked the thymus above the heart in the diagram's front view.
examples.zh: 我们在正视图中将「胸腺」标在心脏上方。

collocations: T cell development in the thymus

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid tissue mass in the throat region associated with its lining

examples.en: The diagram shows a tonsil beside the opening to the throat.
examples.zh: 示意图在咽部开口旁画出了一个「扁桃体」。

examples.en: We highlighted the tonsil in the model of the upper throat.
examples.zh: 我们在上部咽腔模型中高亮标出了「扁桃体」。

words.enDefinition: Organ providing a site for the development and maturation of lymphocytes

examples.en: The class lists the thymus as one example of a primary lymphoid organ.
examples.zh: 课堂将胸腺列为「初级淋巴器官」的一个例子。

examples.en: We placed a primary lymphoid organ near the beginning of the lymphocyte development chart.
examples.zh: 我们将「初级淋巴器官」放在淋巴细胞发育图的起始位置附近。

collocations: example of a primary lymphoid organ
function of a primary lymphoid organ

words.enDefinition: Organ where mature lymphocytes encounter antigens and can mount responses

examples.en: The table lists a lymph node as a secondary lymphoid organ in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，表格把淋巴结列为「次级淋巴器官」。

examples.en: We marked where cells gather within a secondary lymphoid organ in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中标出了细胞在「次级淋巴器官」内聚集的位置。

collocations: example of a secondary lymphoid organ
function of a secondary lymphoid organ

words.enDefinition: Collection of immune cells organized within or beneath mucosal linings

examples.en: The drawing shows mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue close to the surface lining of the intestine.
examples.zh: 图中，「黏膜相关淋巴组织」靠近肠道的表面内衬。

examples.en: We highlighted mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue on the diagram before labeling the surrounding tissue layers.
examples.zh: 我们先在示意图中标出「黏膜相关淋巴组织」，再标注周围各层组织。

words.enDefinition: Network of cells, tissues, and signals that recognizes and responds to threats

examples.en: The immune system diagram connects several tissues through arrows representing their interactions.
examples.zh: 「免疫系统」示意图用箭头连接几种组织，表示它们之间的相互作用。

examples.en: We grouped these cells by their roles in the immune system chart.
examples.zh: 我们在「免疫系统」图表中按作用将这些细胞分组。

words.enDefinition: Rapid defenses that respond through broadly shared recognition patterns

examples.en: The textbook lists surface barriers as part of innate immunity in its overview.
examples.zh: 教材在概述中将体表屏障列为「先天免疫」的组成部分。

examples.en: We labeled innate immunity on the early side of the classroom response chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反应图的较早阶段标出了「先天免疫」。

words.enDefinition: Defense that targets specific antigens and can produce lasting cellular memory

examples.en: The adaptive immunity diagram follows one selected cell group through several possible outcomes.
examples.zh: 「适应性免疫」图沿着一个被选择的细胞群展示了几种可能的后续情况。

examples.en: We highlighted the memory phase in the classroom model of adaptive immunity.
examples.zh: 我们在「适应性免疫」课堂模型中高亮标出了记忆阶段。

words.enDefinition: Protective boundary formed by a mucous membrane and material covering its surface

examples.en: The cutaway shows the mucosal barrier along the exposed side of the lining.
examples.zh: 剖视图显示「黏膜屏障」沿内衬朝向腔隙的一侧分布。

examples.en: We colored the mucosal barrier before labeling cells in the tissue beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们先给「黏膜屏障」上色，再标出下方组织里的细胞。

words.enDefinition: Immune cell belonging to one of the body's white blood cell groups

examples.en: The drawing labels each leukocyte separately from the surrounding red cells.
examples.zh: 示意图将各个「白细胞」与周围的红细胞分开标注。

examples.en: We matched each leukocyte drawing with its category on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中将各个「白细胞」图形与其类别配对。

words.enDefinition: White blood cell with conspicuous cytoplasmic granules in standard tissue images

examples.en: The atlas shows a granulocyte with several visible dots inside its outline.
examples.zh: 图谱展示一个「粒细胞」，其轮廓以内有几个可见的小点。

examples.en: We assigned the picture to the granulocyte category after examining its internal granules.
examples.zh: 我们观察细胞内部的颗粒后，将图中细胞归入「粒细胞」一类。

words.enDefinition: White blood cell lacking the prominent granules characteristic of granulocytes

examples.en: The agranulocyte figure lacks the prominent dots shown in the neighboring image.
examples.zh: 这幅「无粒白细胞」图没有相邻图像中那些醒目的小点。

examples.en: We labeled both examples of the agranulocyte group on the comparison chart.
examples.zh: 我们在对比图上标出了「无粒白细胞」组的两个例子。

words.enDefinition: Abundant granulocyte with a segmented nucleus that can engulf cellular debris

examples.en: The model shows a neutrophil with its nucleus divided into several lobes.
examples.zh: 模型展示一个细胞核分为多叶的「中性粒细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the neutrophil in the atlas after examining its segmented nucleus.
examples.zh: 我们观察它的分叶细胞核后，在图谱中标出了「中性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Granulocyte typically showing a two-lobed nucleus and prominent reddish cytoplasmic granules

examples.en: The textbook drawing shows an eosinophil with two prominent nuclear lobes.
examples.zh: 教材示意图展示一个具有两个明显核叶的「嗜酸性粒细胞」。

examples.en: We labeled the eosinophil beside a cell with a more segmented nucleus.
examples.zh: 我们在一个细胞核分叶更多的细胞旁标出了「嗜酸性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Circulating granulocyte with dark granules containing histamine and other signaling substances

examples.en: The atlas depicts a basophil with dark granules across much of the cell.
examples.zh: 图谱展示一个「嗜碱性粒细胞」，其大部分区域可见深色颗粒。

examples.en: We located the basophil on the chart of circulating immune cells.
examples.zh: 我们在循环中的免疫细胞图表上找到了「嗜碱性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue-resident immune cell storing signaling substances such as histamine in granules

examples.en: The model places a mast cell among the cells in the supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 模型将一个「肥大细胞」画在支撑组织的其他细胞之间。

examples.en: We marked the granules inside the illustrated mast cell in our class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上标出了图示「肥大细胞」内部的颗粒。

words.enDefinition: Circulating white blood cell that can give rise to tissue macrophages

examples.en: The textbook shows a monocyte with a curved nucleus in the drawing.
examples.zh: 教材图展示一个细胞核呈弯曲形的「单核细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the monocyte in the blood portion of the development chart.
examples.zh: 我们在发育图的血液部分标出了「单核细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Large immune cell that engulfs debris and helps organize local responses

examples.en: The animation shows a macrophage surrounding a piece of cellular debris.
examples.zh: 动画显示一个「巨噬细胞」正在包围一块细胞碎片。

examples.en: We labeled a macrophage among the cells in the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂组织模型的细胞群中标出了一个「巨噬细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Immune cell specialized in presenting antigens and initiating certain adaptive responses

examples.en: The model depicts a dendritic cell with several projections extending from its surface.
examples.zh: 模型展示一个表面伸出多个突起的「树突状细胞」。

examples.en: We placed the dendritic cell beside the lymphocyte on the labeled diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在标注图中把「树突状细胞」画在淋巴细胞旁。

words.enDefinition: Innate lymphocyte capable of eliminating certain stressed or abnormal body cells

examples.en: The model places a natural killer cell next to a stressed body cell.
examples.zh: 模型将一个「自然杀伤细胞」画在处于应激状态的人体细胞旁。

examples.en: We highlighted the natural killer cell in the chart of innate cell types.
examples.zh: 我们在先天免疫细胞类型图中高亮标出了「自然杀伤细胞」。

collocations: role of a natural killer cell
diagram of a natural killer cell

words.enDefinition: Cell capable of surrounding and taking solid material into its interior

examples.en: The drawing shows a phagocyte around a small fragment of damaged tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图展示一个「吞噬细胞」围住一小块受损组织碎片。

examples.en: We labeled the phagocyte in the sequence showing debris being taken inside.
examples.zh: 我们在碎片被摄入的连续示意图中标出了「吞噬细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Process by which a cell encloses solid material and takes it inside

examples.en: The teaching animation illustrates phagocytosis using a piece of old cellular material.
examples.zh: 教学动画用一块老化的细胞碎片说明「吞噬作用」。

examples.en: We drew arrows to indicate phagocytosis in the diagram of debris removal.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头在清理碎片的示意图中表示「吞噬作用」。

words.enDefinition: Coordinated tissue and vascular changes following a local injury

examples.en: The diagram shows an inflammatory response concentrated around the shaded tissue area.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「炎症反应」集中在阴影组织区周围。

examples.en: We used a timeline to summarize the early inflammatory response shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们用时间轴概括了课堂展示的早期「炎症反应」。

words.enDefinition: Signaling substance stored by certain immune cells that affects local vessels

examples.en: The chart depicts histamine as one signal released by the illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 图表将「组胺」画成图示细胞释放的一种信号。

examples.en: We linked histamine with changes in nearby vessels on the simplified diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化图中将「组胺」与附近血管的变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Small signaling protein that helps coordinate the behavior of nearby or distant cells

examples.en: The illustration uses a small arrow to represent a cytokine between cells.
examples.zh: 插图用一个小箭头表示细胞之间传递的「细胞因子」。

examples.en: We labeled one cytokine on the classroom diagram of immune communication.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂免疫信号交流图中标出了一种「细胞因子」。

words.enDefinition: Type of signaling protein that guides the movement of responsive cells

examples.en: The chart uses a chemokine arrow to show why cells gather there.
examples.zh: 图表用「趋化因子」箭头说明细胞为何在图示位置聚集。

examples.en: We marked the source of the chemokine in the illustrated tissue.
examples.zh: 我们在图示组织中标出了「趋化因子」的来源。

words.enDefinition: Group of circulating and surface proteins that cooperate in immune responses

examples.en: The chart groups several interacting proteins under the title complement system.
examples.zh: 图表将几种相互作用的蛋白归到「补体系统」这个标题下。

examples.en: We distinguished the complement system from the immune cells in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中区分了「补体系统」和免疫细胞。

words.enDefinition: Molecular structure that can be recognized by an antibody or lymphocyte receptor

examples.en: The worksheet uses a colored shape to represent an antigen.
examples.zh: 习题用有颜色的形状表示一个「抗原」。

examples.en: We marked an antigen on the surface of the illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 我们在图示细胞的表面标出了一个「抗原」。

words.enDefinition: Specific part of an antigen recognized by an antibody or lymphocyte receptor

examples.en: The model highlights one epitope as a small part of the larger shape.
examples.zh: 模型将大图形上较小的一部分高亮标为「抗原表位」。

examples.en: We labeled the epitope near the matching shape in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们在教材中与相应形状相邻的位置标出了「抗原表位」。

words.enDefinition: Protein produced by B-lineage cells that binds a particular antigen structure

examples.en: The diagram represents an antibody with two arms and a stem.
examples.zh: 示意图用两条臂和一个柄表示「抗体」。

examples.en: We labeled the antibody beside the cell that secretes it in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中分泌「抗体」的细胞旁标出了这种蛋白。

words.enDefinition: Part of an antibody or receptor that contacts its corresponding antigen

examples.en: We highlighted the antigen-binding site at the end of one illustrated antibody arm.
examples.zh: 我们在图示抗体一条臂的末端高亮标出了「抗原结合位点」。

examples.en: The textbook shows the antigen-binding site as a small area within the larger outline.
examples.zh: 教材将「抗原结合位点」画成较大轮廓内的一小片区域。

words.enDefinition: Cell displaying antigen fragments on its surface for recognition by T cells

examples.en: The drawing shows an antigen-presenting cell facing a T cell across a narrow space.
examples.zh: 图中「抗原呈递细胞」与一个 T 细胞隔着窄隙相对。

examples.en: We located the antigen-presenting cell on the display side of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中呈递抗原的一侧找到了「抗原呈递细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Display of antigen fragments on a cell surface for T cell recognition

examples.en: The figure illustrates antigen presentation using a small symbol on the outer membrane.
examples.zh: 图中用外膜上的一个小符号说明「抗原呈递」。

examples.en: We marked antigen presentation just before recognition in the textbook's simplified sequence.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的简化顺序图中将「抗原呈递」标在识别之前。

words.enDefinition: Immune cell belonging to the B cell, T cell, or natural killer groups

examples.en: The chart uses separate branches for each major lymphocyte group in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图表用不同分支表示「淋巴细胞」的各主要类群。

examples.en: We identified a lymphocyte among several cells pictured in the node.
examples.zh: 我们在淋巴结图示的几个细胞中找到了一个「淋巴细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive immune cell that can give rise to antibody-secreting and memory cells

examples.en: The worksheet follows a B lymphocyte toward two different outcomes in the chart.
examples.zh: 习题沿图表追踪一个「B淋巴细胞」的两种不同后续情况。

examples.en: We marked the B lymphocyte before labeling the antibody-producing descendant beside it.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「B淋巴细胞」，再标注旁边产生抗体的后代细胞。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive immune cell that matures in the thymus and performs specialized responses

examples.en: The diagram links a developing T lymphocyte with the thymus in the model.
examples.zh: 示意图把发育中的「T淋巴细胞」与模型里的胸腺联系起来。

examples.en: We placed the T lymphocyte at the start of several branches in the chart.
examples.zh: 我们把「T淋巴细胞」放在图表的几个分支起点处。

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that sends signals helping coordinate other immune cells' responses

examples.en: The flowchart shows a helper T cell sending signals to other immune cells.
examples.zh: 流程图显示「辅助性T细胞」向其他免疫细胞发送信号。

examples.en: We followed the arrows leaving the helper T cell in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂模型中从「辅助性T细胞」引出的箭头查看信号走向。

collocations: signals from a helper T cell
role of a helper T cell

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that can recognize and eliminate certain abnormal body cells

examples.en: The chart places a cytotoxic T cell next to the abnormal body cell.
examples.zh: 图表把一个「细胞毒性T细胞」画在异常人体细胞旁。

examples.en: We labeled the cytotoxic T cell separately from the helper cell in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中分别标出了「细胞毒性T细胞」和辅助性 T 细胞。

collocations: role of a cytotoxic T cell
diagram of a cytotoxic T cell

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that restrains immune responses and helps maintain tolerance

examples.en: The flowchart shows a regulatory T cell limiting the response of another cell group.
examples.zh: 流程图显示一个「调节性T细胞」限制另一组细胞的反应。

examples.en: We marked the regulatory T cell next to the inhibitory symbol in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的抑制符号旁标出了「调节性T细胞」。

collocations: role of a regulatory T cell
diagram of a regulatory T cell

words.enDefinition: Differentiated B-lineage cell specialized for producing and secreting large amounts of antibody

examples.en: The textbook shows a plasma cell with antibody symbols around its outline.
examples.zh: 教材展示一个「浆细胞」，其轮廓周围有表示抗体的符号。

examples.en: We placed the plasma cell at the end of the antibody-producing branch.
examples.zh: 我们把「浆细胞」放在产生抗体的分支末端。

collocations: antibody secretion by a plasma cell

words.enDefinition: Long-lived B lymphocyte that can respond rapidly when its antigen reappears

examples.en: The chart places a memory B cell on the branch that remains after the response.
examples.zh: 图表将一个「记忆B细胞」画在反应结束后仍存在的细胞分支上。

examples.en: We followed the memory B cell from the first encounter to the later example.
examples.zh: 我们沿示意图从首次接触追踪「记忆B细胞」到后续情境。

collocations: role of a memory B cell
diagram of a memory B cell

words.enDefinition: Long-lived T lymphocyte able to respond after another encounter with its antigen

examples.en: The classroom diagram keeps a memory T cell in the picture after other cells decline.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图中，其他细胞数量减少后仍画有「记忆T细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the memory T cell on the later part of the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在时间轴的后段标出了「记忆T细胞」。

collocations: role of a memory T cell
diagram of a memory T cell

words.enDefinition: Ability to respond differently after previous recognition of the same antigen

examples.en: The synthetic graph uses two encounters to illustrate immune memory in the class model.
examples.zh: 合成曲线用两次接触说明课堂模型中的「免疫记忆」。

examples.en: We labeled immune memory on the diagram linking earlier and later responses.
examples.zh: 我们在连接早期和后期反应的示意图中标出了「免疫记忆」。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive defense mediated mainly by antibodies released into body fluids

examples.en: The chart uses antibody symbols for the humoral immunity branch of the response.
examples.zh: 图表用抗体符号表示这一反应中的「体液免疫」分支。

examples.en: We linked humoral immunity to the antibody-producing cells in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们将「体液免疫」与课堂图表中产生抗体的细胞联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive defense mediated mainly by T cells and their effects on other cells

examples.en: The figure groups the T cell effects under cell-mediated immunity in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图将 T 细胞的多种作用归到「细胞介导免疫」之下。

examples.en: We followed the cell-mediated immunity branch to the body cells shown in the model.
examples.zh: 我们沿「细胞介导免疫」分支追踪到模型中所示的人体细胞。

words.enDefinition: Preferential activation of lymphocytes whose receptors recognize a particular antigen

examples.en: The chart illustrates clonal selection by highlighting one matching cell among several options.
examples.zh: 图表通过高亮多个候选细胞中一个匹配的细胞来说明「克隆选择」。

examples.en: We placed clonal selection before the increase in matching cells on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「克隆选择」标在相匹配的细胞数量增加之前。

words.enDefinition: Antigen-specific nonresponsiveness of the immune system, including its normal nonreaction to many of the body's own structures.

examples.en: The lecture illustrates immune tolerance with a diagram of the body's own markers.
examples.zh: 课堂通过人体自身标志的示意图说明「免疫耐受」。

examples.en: We placed immune tolerance beside the low-response outcome in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中把「免疫耐受」标在低反应结果的旁边。
